Keep one owner-run terminal/session for the approved campaign and its immutable output directory; do not start494 permission requests. Physical pose readiness and authority are separate: the single exact approved packet authorizes only its finite operations, while each pose still needs actual human readiness. At each Configurator and boot checkpoint stop for the listed comparisons. Do not advance on an unresolved response, mismatch, missing original, recovery flag, uncertain write, unavailable expected identity, parser refusal or capture failure.

For each scheduled boot, perform the known ordinary entry/restart only when that event permits it. Release all controls before ordinary USB restart; never use runtime mode/backend chords or watchdog switching as a substitute. Menu→Configurator also restarts firmware:24 of those plus26 ordinary USB restarts give50 proposed firmware restarts. The26 gameplay-route boots are22 active native, one selected-native mismatch/NativeUnavailable refusal, and three genuine original legacy4 boots. Neutral refusal is never called legacy fallback. Ordinary startup may change existing firmware bookkeeping; neither restart nor public restore promises byte-identical device state.

The approved operator may delegate the fixed host commands to the agent, but the agent must never synthesize human READY/held-input evidence. Show `case_run_id`, physical input names/IDs, exact prefix and next held set from the row. The owner physically establishes that state, retaining prescribed controls between ordered steps, and explicitly confirms `READY <case_run_id>`. Preserve the actual response/transcript reference and record its provenance. There is no timed input injection/macro, no hidden SDK read and no inserted release/reset inside a group. Repeating a stable held plateau is source-idempotent; no fixed dwell frame count is claimed. No additional settling delay is required by this proposal; if the owner takes time to reach READY it is recorded human dwell before capture, outside the reader's five-second acquisition window.
